hook.name: LaunchHookProbe
hook.description: Singleton hook for pools created by LaunchFactory that takes a fixed trading fee (set at creation, capped at 5%) always on the stock currency (currency0). Fees are split between a platform treasury (30%), a creator recipient, and token holders. Only a designated locker may add liquidity. Supports Beam (1% fixed fee) and Prism (variable fee) launch modes.
